title: Hakodate vs Sapporo: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Hakodate for the night view, atmosphere, and seafood dawns. Sapporo for city life, day trips, and miso ramen. Do both if you have 5+ days in Hokkaido.

categories.name: City Character
categories.summary: Hakodate has more historic charm and a romantic port atmosphere. Sapporo is a modern, functional major city.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Hakodate wins for salt ramen and seafood markets. Sapporo wins for miso ramen, soup curry, and food diversity.

categories.name: Top Attractions
categories.summary: Mount Hakodate night view is world-class. Sapporo's Snow Festival is unmissable in February.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Both are mid-range. Hakodate slightly cheaper overall at ¥8,000–12,000/day vs ¥9,000–14,000/day.

categories.name: Transit
categories.summary: Sapporo has a 4-line subway. Hakodate has a tram (no subway).

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Sapporo: Otaru, Noboribetsu, Furano/Biei. Hakodate: Onuma Park, Matsumae.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Susukino is Hokkaido's best nightlife district. Hakodate is quiet at night.

categories.name: Cherry Blossoms
categories.summary: Goryokaku's star-shaped moat in early May is one of Japan's top sakura spots.

categories.name: Winter Experience
categories.summary: Sapporo Snow Festival (February) is world-famous. Hakodate is beautiful in snow but quieter.

faq.question: Is Hakodate or Sapporo better for a first-time Hokkaido visitor?
faq.answer: Sapporo is the better base. Hakodate is best as a 2-night stop, not a base.

faq.question: How far is Hakodate from Sapporo?
faq.answer: ~3.5-4h by Hokuto Limited Express (~¥8,500), or 40-min flight.

faq.question: Is the Hakodate night view worth it?
faq.answer: Yes — Reddit universally calls it one of Japan's most stunning views. Don't miss it.
